body:
FOLLOW-UP MEASUREMENT: a separate source FILE in the same Test compilation is NOT sufficient. I moved CacheBoundaryShape/TokenBoundaryShape/ReportBoundaryShape into ConstructionBoundaryControls.scala, left the macro in ConstructionBoundarySuite.scala, ran providerParser/clean providerParser/test, and exact `Shape.fromProduct(tuple)` controls still failed with the same six `value fromProduct is not a member` errors. Mirror controls still compile.

So the requirement should say ALREADY-COMPILED EARLIER PHASE/CONFIGURATION (main before test, or upstream module), not merely another source file. I removed the failed direct controls and retained the already-compiled core SurfaceUnit.fromProduct exact positive; clean 68/68 had passed in that shape before the experiment and is being rerun. This changes no production repair. The separate file remains useful for exact-shaped constructor/apply/copy/Mirror controls, which do compile from a clean build.
